concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-003 (CPU‑only pipeline without CUDA/8‑bit/4‑bit libraries) is not referenced by any task in the Phase & Task Mapping. The spec demands a CPU‑only implementation, but the plan never explicitly addresses this requirement.

Success Criterion SC-005 (computational feasibility: ≤ 6 h wall‑clock, ≤ 7 GB RAM) is absent from the task mapping. No task claims to verify or enforce the runtime and memory limits required by the spec.
